Sprint 3 CodeRabbit Critical/Major fixes (2026-05-16): (1) Fail-closed policy gate — issue.update/delete now require final_decision=='allow', no longer pass approval_required. (2) Audit-first ordering — before/after states pre-computed; audit_client.append() before repo.save(); ensures no mutated-but-unaudited state. (3) delete return value checked → 409 on race. (4) AnthropicLLMClient defensive env access with explicit RuntimeError. (5) policy decision_store: tz UTC-normalized, try/except + rollback. (6) audit hash_ref now JSON-serialized to remove ambiguity collisions. (7) verify_chain uses append-order snapshot under lock. 274/274 PASS preserved, N=5 STABLE criterion met for Sprint 3 重要変更

(3) Audit AuditEventStore — 11 tests (hash chain integrity, concurrent append, tamper detection via verify_chain). (2) docker-smoke job (audit service healthcheck) added — all 8 Python service Docker healthchecks migrated from httpx (not in prod) to urllib.request (stdlib). (3) Issue #6: federation-service 13 policy propagation tests (risk_score/policy_result_ref/reasoning_summary/outcome mapping/three-company scenario). Created tests/e2e/test_governance_e2e.py covering 3 cross-service governance flows: (1) Audit hash chain integrity (chain valid after 3 events, genesis on empty tenant, tenant isolation), (2) Federation cross-service e2e (real audit store wired via _AuditAdapter TestClient adapter — allow/deny/multi-event chain), (3) AI Gateway governance e2e (policy gate + audit trail — allow/deny ADR-006 preserved, chain integrity). Root-cause fixed: 7 AuditEventType enum values missing from synapse_shared/audit_base.py (AIInvoked/AIBlocked/AIMasked/AIRoutedLocal/AIReviewRequired/FederationBlocked/FederationReviewRequired) — invisible in StubAuditClient tests but exposed when cross-service adapter hit real Pydantic validation. All 5 CI jobs: lint/test/frontend-build/docker-smoke/security. STABLE N=3 criterion met.

Issue #8 closed (Sprint3 tdd_required: 4 target files 57 tests PASS — ai-gateway:10/audit:11/object:25/policy:11). Sprint 6 G3 PostgreSQL (2026-05-23): 364/364 PASS (+14 DB config tests). (1) database.py _resolve_db_config() — DATABASE_URL > SQLITE_DB > :memory: 優先順位。(2) Dockerfile[postgres] extra — psycopg2-binary を本番 Docker に含める critical fix。(3) FastAPI lifespan startup — init_db() で PostgreSQL 起動時テーブル自動作成。(4) Alembic マイグレーション — alembic.ini/env.py/versions/0001_initial_schema.py (object/policy 両サービス, render_as_batch=True)。(5) docker-compose postgres:16-alpine サービス追加 (pg_isready ヘルスチェック)。(6) CI test-postgres ジョブ追加 — 6/6 jobs SUCCESS。(7) Frontend: Dashboard KPI cards + Sprint progress table + ASCII arch diagram + ServiceHealth.tsx + error.tsx + loading.tsx。PR #5/#9/#10 全 main マージ完了 + PR #12 open. G2/G3 gate 達成。STABLE N=5 (通常N=3超過)。

Sprint 7 G4 Federation Demo (2026-05-27): 384/384 PASS (+20 federation-demo tests). (1) federation_demo.py — GET /federation-demo/scenario 静的エンドポイント。ADR-002 準拠 (read-only)。3社間シナリオ: A→B APPROVED/L3/shared, A→C BLOCKED/L1/source_only, B→C REVIEW_REQUIRED/L2/shared。(2) test_federation_demo.py — 20 テスト: schema field names/ADR-002 cross-tenant/status coverage/audit_boundary/trust_level/risk_score/idempotency。(3) object-service delete_issue: response_model=None + explicit Response(204) で FastAPI 0.115.0 AssertionError 修正。(4) workflow-service approvals.py: HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY → integer 422 (Starlette version-agnostic fix, -W error::DeprecationWarning CI 失敗解消)。(5) Frontend FederationEvent schema: source_tenant/target_tenant (not _id suffix), dlp_triggered 除去, getFederationDemoScenario() 追加。STABLE N=3 (CI 連続成功: run 26508306977/26508310254/26508492247)。

Sprint 8 G5 Frontend Auth + Dashboard (2026-05-27): JWT 認証フロー完全実装。(1) web/lib/session.ts — SESSION_COOKIE 共有定数 + cookieOptions (httpOnly/sameSite=lax/secure in prod/maxAge=3600)。(2) web/app/api/auth/login/route.ts — POST /auth/token プロキシ → httpOnly cookie セット、401/400/503 ステータス整理。(3) web/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts — cookie 削除。(4) web/middleware.ts — Edge middleware で全保護ルート -> /login リダイレクト (next param 付き)、PUBLIC_PATHS=[/login,/api/auth/*]。(5) web/app/login/page.tsx — Client Component ログインフォーム + safeNextPath() で Open Redirect 防御 (`//evil.com` や scheme 付き URL を拒否)。(6) web/app/layout.tsx — Server Component で cookie 読み取り + /auth/me 呼び出し、user prop を Sidebar に渡す。(7) web/components/Sidebar.tsx — user props 受け取り + logout ボタン追加。(8) Dashboard page.tsx Sprint 8 状態反映: 384 tests、Sprint 7 G4 Open PR 行追加、Sprint 8 G5 In Progress 行追加、ASCII アーキ図に JWT Auth flow 反映、ヘッダ Sprint 6 → Sprint 8。Issues #15/#16 対応。security review Medium (Open Redirect) は safeNextPath() で同一オリジン制約により解消。

Sprint 8 G5 typedRoutes 修正 (2026-05-27, 022a9d8): Next.js 14 experimental.typedRoutes 有効環境で router.push(string) は RouteImpl<string> 型を要求。app/login/page.tsx で `import type { Route } from 'next'` を追加し `router.push(next as Route)` にキャスト。同パターンは Sidebar.tsx の Sprint 5 typedRoutes fix と一貫。CI 6 jobs × 2 trigger runs (26509706761/26509712619) all SUCCESS、Sprint 8 G5 STABLE N=1/3 達成 (Sprint 7 STABLE 状態は Sprint 境界でリセット)。教訓: typedRoutes は実行時ではなく Next.js build 時の TypeScript チェックで失敗するため、Edge middleware や Server Component で型推論されない外部入力 (searchParams.get) を router.push に渡す場面では明示的 cast が必須。

Sprint 9 G5+G6 Governance Gates (2026-05-30/2026-06-06): 396/396 PASS (+12: G5×2 + G6×10)。G5: tests/governance/test_no_direct_ai_access.py — AST静的解析でai-gateway以外のAI SDK直接インポートを検出 (ADR-001 CI強制)。G6: GET /audit-events/export (CSV/JSON) — ISO/J-SOX監査証跡エクスポート、7フィールド (audit_event_id/event_type/occurred_at/tenant_id/actor_id/hash_ref/previous_hash_ref)。Security: web/package.json overrides.glob=^10.5.0 (GHSA-5j98解消、npm audit high 4→1、残1件はnext@14.x DoS Accepted Risk)。Docker: restart:unless-stopped 全11サービス。CI 4連続成功 → STABLE N=4 (target N=3超過)。PR #22 open sprint/9-governance-audit→main。全6 Governance Gates完了: G1-G6 ✅。PostToolUse hook pattern: state.json Edit後に自動フォーマットされるため、連続Edit時は必ずRead→Edit→(hook)→Read→Edit の順を守ること。

Sprint 10 Quality (2026-06-06): 396/396 PASS (Python) + 31/31 PASS (vitest)。Issue #23 frontend-test: vitest環境構築 + session.test.ts (7テスト) + login/route.test.ts (8テスト) + csrf/url-safety/route-access (16テスト) = 31テスト。Issue #24 deploy-prep: docs/deployment/PRODUCTION_DEPLOY.md (本番デプロイ手順書) 作成 + deploy.ready=true セット。Issue #25 nextjs-upgrade: next.js 14→15 アップグレード (next@15.5.19, eslint-config-next@15.5.19)。Next.js 15 breaking change: cookies()/headers() が async Promise 返却に変更 → web/app/layout.tsx + web/lib/session.ts で await 追加 (getToken async化)。2件のHIGH CVE解消: GHSA-9g9p-9gw9-jx7f (Image Optimizer DoS) / GHSA-h25m-26qc-wcjf (RSC deserialization DoS)。middleware.ts は NextRequest.cookies (同期) を使用のため変更不要。vitest@4 (esbuild chain moderate) は dev-only のため次スプリント以降で対応。PR #26 open sprint/10-quality→main。CI all success。

Sprint 11 Quality (2026-06-07): 396/396 PASS (Python) + 32/32 PASS (vitest)。Issue #28 vitest-branch-coverage: @vitest/coverage-v8@^2.1.9 追加, vitest.config.ts thresholds (branches≥90%/functions≥85%/lines≥85%), 対象5ファイル (lib/csrf.ts/url-safety.ts/session.ts/route-access.ts/app/api/auth/login/route.ts), CI upload-artifact@v4 integration (SHA ea165f8d→@v4 tag fix), Coverage実績: Branches 100%/Functions 85.71%/Lines 96.58%。Issue #29 security-headers: 5 HTTP security headers in next.config.js (X-Content-Type-Options/X-Frame-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/CSP), sameSite cookie Lax→Strict (session.ts+logout/route.ts), COOKIE_SECURE env var (not NODE_ENV) で build-time baking 防止。教訓: actions/upload-artifact の SHA ピン有効期限切れ → @v4 tag fallback で CI 即回復。CORS allow_origins=['*']+credentials=True は全9 backend service に存在 (内部サービスのみ・即時リスク低) → Sprint 12 課題。PR #30 open sprint/11-quality→main。CI 6 jobs all SUCCESS。

Sprint 12 Quality (2026-06-17): 396/396 PASS (Python) + 32/32 PASS (vitest)。Issue #31 cors-env-configurable: RFC 6454 CORS spec violation 修正。allow_origins=['*']+allow_credentials=True はブラウザに CORS レスポンスを拒否させる禁止組み合わせ。8 backend services (ai-gateway/audit/dashboard/federation/knowledge/object/tenant-identity/workflow) の CORSMiddleware を CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS 環境変数ベースの設定に変更。docker-compose.yml 全サービスに CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS 注入 (default http://localhost:3000)。教訓1: ruff E402 — _cors_origins = [...] 変数代入を内部 from .api import ... の前に置くと、後続の import が E402 (module level import not at top) 違反になる。全 internal import を変数代入より前に配置することで解消。教訓2: context compaction 後に Edit する場合はファイルを Read してから行うこと (file-not-read-yet エラー防止)。PR open sprint/12-quality→main。
